title: Index entry
description: One line of index.jsonl: the current state of one source or one wiki note. The index is a projection of history.jsonl, keeping the last entry per id, so an entry here always has the same shape as the history line it came from. Run markers are skipped by compaction and never appear in the index.

source.description: A source note in the person's own tree. The id is the full vault-relative path, never the basename, because real archives have basename collisions.

status.description: excluded is the confidentiality escape hatch, declared by the person and never processed. renamed and deleted retire a path without dropping it.

produced.description: Wiki notes citing this source. Empty means processed but unlinked.

declared.description: When the person declared this source, recorded on an excluded source where there is no processed date.

then.description: An excluded source is never read, so it has no content hash.

note.description: A compiled wiki note. type equals the subfolder it sits in, so a mismatch is visible from the index alone.

kind.description: Exactly one per concept or entity. Tension and hub notes carry none.

compiled_from.description: Each pair is a source id with the hash it carried at compile time. Staleness is a direct comparison against the source's current hash, so a null hash breaks detection for that pair silently: the comparison can never match. The hash is therefore required. One history line from 2026-09-09 carries a null and is rejected by this schema on purpose; it was superseded by a later entry and the current index is clean, and history is never rewritten to suit a schema.

unincorporated.description: Hubs only. Sources added to the links without the body being rebuilt. Triggers a rebuild at ten.

auto.description: The cycle made this write on its own judgement. Paired with run, it is what the audit surface and the undo script read.

run.description: The run that made this write. A cycle writes <op>-run-<date>; a write applied at the sweep writes <op>-<date>. The undo script takes either.

flag_log.description: Corrections raised against this note: the quality signal the sweep reads as a rate.
